options.label: BWL-Tätigkeit im Büro
options.value: The person works on a business administration task at an office desk. A laptop, spreadsheet-like screen, notebook, printed documents, calculator, and organized papers are visible on the desk. The person is reviewing figures, notes, or business documents in a focused work moment.

options.label: Digitale Projektarbeit
options.value: The person works on a digital project using a laptop, tablet, or large screen. A digital workspace, notes, simple diagrams, and project materials are visible. The task looks like planning, checking, organizing, or coordinating digital work.

options.label: Kundenberatung am Arbeitsplatz
options.value: The person is in a consultation situation at a desk or counter. A laptop, form, folder, notebook, or product document is placed between the person and the consultation area. The person appears to explain, check, or prepare information for a customer-facing work task.

options.label: Tischlerarbeit / Holzverarbeitung
options.value: The person performs a woodworking task at a workbench. Wooden boards, measuring tools, pencil marks, clamps, sanding block, and simple hand tools are visible. The person is measuring, checking, marking, sanding, or assembling a wooden piece.

options.label: Elektrikerarbeit / Installation
options.value: The person works on an electrical installation task. Cables, cable channels, a wall outlet, a junction box, measuring device, screwdriver, and organized electrical components are visible. The person is checking, connecting, measuring, or preparing an electrical component.

options.label: Bauarbeit auf der Baustelle
options.value: The person performs a construction task on a building site. Building materials, tools, measuring tape, plans, unfinished walls, scaffolding, or construction elements are visible. The person is checking measurements, reviewing plans, carrying materials, or working near a construction element.

options.label: Tiefbau / Straßen- und Leitungsbau
options.value: The person works in a civil engineering or underground construction setting. A trench, pipes, measuring equipment, construction plans, ground markings, compacted soil, or roadwork elements are visible. The person is checking alignment, reviewing plans, measuring, or preparing work near the trench.

options.label: Logistik / Lagerorganisation
options.value: The person works in a warehouse or logistics area. Shelves, packages, labels, handheld scanner, clipboard, pallet, cart, or organized storage boxes are visible. The person is checking inventory, scanning an item, moving a package, or reviewing a delivery list.

options.label: Technische Wartung / Reparatur
options.value: The person works on a technical maintenance task. A machine, device, tool case, screws, measuring device, open service panel, or technical component is visible. The person is inspecting, adjusting, checking, or repairing a practical technical element.

options.label: Planung mit Bau- oder Technikunterlagen
options.value: The person reviews technical or construction-related documents at a table. Blueprints, printed plans, measuring tools, notebook, laptop, or marked drawings are visible. The person is comparing plan details, pointing at a drawing, or checking measurements.

options.label: Allein bei einer klaren Aufgabe
options.value: The person works alone on one clearly visible task. The workspace is organized around this task, and no other person is visible. The uploaded person is the only subject in the image.

options.label: Allein konzentriert am Arbeitsplatz
options.value: The person is alone in a focused work moment. The hands, gaze, and body position are directed toward the task or work object. The surrounding objects support the activity without distracting from the person.

options.label: Mit einer weiteren Person im Austausch
options.value: The person works with one colleague nearby. Both are oriented toward the same work object, document, screen, tool, plan, or material. The uploaded person remains the clear main subject.

options.label: Eine Person erklärt einer anderen etwas
options.value: The uploaded person explains a work step to one colleague. One hand may point toward a document, screen, tool, plan, material, or work object. The colleague listens or looks at the same object.

options.label: Eine Person erhält praktische Anleitung
options.value: The uploaded person receives or gives practical guidance during a work task. One colleague is close enough to observe the same object, tool, document, plan, or work area. The scene shows a concrete learning or instruction moment.

options.label: Zwei Personen arbeiten gemeinsam an einem Objekt
options.value: The uploaded person and one colleague work together on the same visible object, tool, document, screen, plan, material, or workplace element. Their body positions show shared attention to the same task.

options.label: Kleines Team bespricht eine Aufgabe
options.value: A small team of two or three people stands or sits around a shared table, screen, plan, tool, material, or work area. The uploaded person is closest to the camera and remains the clear main subject.

options.label: Team prüft einen Plan oder Arbeitsstand
options.value: The uploaded person is part of a small team reviewing a plan, checklist, screen, drawing, or visible work result. Fingers or hands point toward the same material, and the group attention is focused on the task.

options.label: Kurze Abstimmung direkt am Arbeitsort
options.value: The uploaded person takes part in a short work discussion directly at the place where the task happens. A colleague or small team stands nearby, and the relevant work object, plan, tool, material, or construction element is visible.

options.label: Übergabe oder Kontrolle eines Arbeitsergebnisses
options.value: The uploaded person checks or hands over a visible work result, document, material, tool, plan, package, or technical component. One colleague may be present and looking at the same result.
